text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Manchester United and Fulham at Old Trafford!
United have looked a different team since the start of the year, and are yet to lose a game so far in 2024 in all competitions (W6 D1).

They've won their last four Premier League games in a row, holding on last weekend to beat Luton Town 2-1 to extend that run, and a fifth consecutive win here would move them level on points with Tottenham in fifth.
They have a good record against Fulham, going unbeaten in their last 16 league games against the Cottagers (W13 D3).

Fulham, on the other hand, have won just twice since the turn of the year (D3 L4), with both of those victories coming at Craven Cottage, and only one of them was in the Premier League when they beat Bournemouth 3-1.

This run has seen them drop to 12th in the table, but Marco Silva will be keen to try and get just their second win away from home in the league this season, having gone winless in 11 on the road since beating Everton in their opening match (D4 L7).
Erik ten Hag makes two changes from their win over Luton last Sunday, and they're both enforced.
Luke Shaw went off with a muscle problem at half-time in that game, while Rasmus Hojlund, who scored seven goals in his last six games, also misses out through injury.
Lindelof and Forson come in, with the latter making his first senior start for the club.
Silva makes six changes to his side after their loss to Aston Villa last weekend as Adarabioyo, Bassey, Reed, Lukic, Wilson and Iwobi are all brought in.
Diop, Ream, Cairney and De Cordova-Reid drop to the bench, where Tete and Broja also start after passing late checks.
Joao Palhinha is suspended after getting his 10th booking of the season, while William is out with a hamstring injury.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Muniz gets the game under way for Fulham!
Lukic nudges Mainoo on the ball, and his team-mates rush forward to get up with him in support.
The United youngster recovers quickly to force him wide though, and no cross goes into the hosts' box.
Fulham have made a bright start here, and Iwobi makes a good run down the left.
He can't pick out a cross, so checks back to lay it off to Pereira instead.
He curls a shot on goal, but it's straight down the middle at Onana.
Robinson goes long, giving Iwobi something to chase down the left.
Onana rushes out of his box to take it out of the winger's path, only to stumble after taking it around him.
He rights himself in time before hooking it to safety.
Fulham have lost 13 of their 16 Premier League away games against United (W1 D2), with their only victory coming under Chris Coleman back in October 2003.
Garnacho slides in with a good tackle to stop Wilson's run, giving away a corner in the process.
Pereira's delivery is cleared at the near post, but the Brazilian gets it back and tries to thread it into Reed, only to overhit it.
United are really struggling to get out of their own half here and look sluggish when they try to close Fulham down.
Bassey is allowed to make a driving run forward from defence, and it's Forson that gets back to stop him.
WIDE! Forson's crossfield pass to Garnacho is cut out by Reed, and he plays it over the top for Muniz.
He nods it down despite being sandwiched between two defenders, and Iwobi runs onto it.
He strikes it first time but drills it wide of the near post.
Fernandes swings United's first corner into the box, and Leno flaps at it, but gets enough contact to take it off Varane's head.
Dalot tries to recycle it, but Casemiro strays offside to meet his cross.
WIDE! Maguire commits to a challenge in midfield, and it opens the space in behind for Fulham as Pereira slides it through for Iwobi.
He takes it to the edge of the box before going for goal, but he sends another shot wide of Onana's left post.
It's a good pass over the top from Casemiro as he looks for Fernandes' run off the back of Adarabioyo.
The defender is at full stretch as he knocks it away from the United captain though, giving away a corner.
GREAT SAVE! Fulham broke with a lightning-quick counter from a United corner to win one of their own at the other end.
Pereira's delivery gets a flick from Muniz in the middle that Onana pushes away, and Lukic can't direct the rebound on goal.
United are enjoying their first long spell of possession here as they try to gain a foothold in this game.
It's all in their own half at the moment though, as they're struggling to get through Fulham's high press.
Casemiro played a wonderful throughball forward for Garnacho, but Adarabioyo tugged him back to stop him from getting there.
He's shown the first booking of the game.
OFF THE LINE! Fulham are all over the place from the resulting free-kick as it pinballs through the box.
Maguire manages to poke it through to Garnacho, whose curling effort is headed away by Robinson.
Maguire gets a chance himself but sends this one over the bar.
BLOCK! Just like their earlier corner, Pereira swings it into Muniz on the left of the box, and he sends another glancing header towards goal.
Casemiro is in the way at the near post though, and he bundles it out for another corner.
Maguire makes another good interception, and Fernandes doesn't waste any time in playing it forward for Rashford to chase.
He gets in between the Fulham centre-backs, but Bassey stretches to cut it out in time.
OFF THE POST! Garnacho manages to switch it out to Dalot on the right just before he's brought down, and the defender has a lot of space on the edge of the box.
He takes the shot early, but it skims the outside of the post on its way wide.
Onana's goal-kick is flicked on by Fernandes, but Garnacho can't open up any space for a shot as he cuts inside.
He lays it off to Mainoo instead, but he gets it all wrong, slicing his shot well wide of the far post.

source.label: assist
source.text: He lays it off to Mainoo

text: OFF THE POST! Iwobi debates curling in a cross but instead squares it to the penalty spot for Muniz.
He spins away from Lindelof into space before hitting his shot.
Onana is static on his line as it smacks the outside of the near post.
Fulham break quickly on the counter once more, with Robinson making a surging run down the left.
He gets too much on it though, whipping it over the crossbar.
Maguire's first touch got away from him, and in his attempt to make up for it, he steps on Lukic's foot.
The referee initially played the advantage, but now goes back to book the defender.
Lukic stays down in need of treatment on his foot, and the physios are brought onto the pitch.
He's moving gingerly when he gets back up, but he's going to be able to carry on.
GOOD SAVE! Another United attack fizzles out, and the visitors race upfield while the space is still there.
Reed helps it onto Pereira, who drives down the left before cutting inside to curl a shot on goal.
Onana is at full stretch to push it wide.
GREAT SAVE! Leno is called into action for the first time in this game as Garnacho cuts inside from the left again.
He whips a shot towards the far post from just outside the box, and the goalkeeper gets a strong hand behind it.
Pereira threw himself into a sliding challenge, though Garnacho neatly skipped away from it with little contact.
It was a poor challenge either way though, and the Brazilian is booked.
United are looking to make a strong finish to this half as they keep Fulham penned back.
Fernandes' corner is taken short to Mainoo, who helps it onto Forson, but his drilled shot hits his own team-mate in the crowd.
Into the first of two added minutes here, and Fulham are back in possession, patiently working it out from the back.
They look to Castange to make something happen this time, but he can't find a way past Lindelof.
Wilson rushes back to get tight to Garnacho but clips the winger's heels in the process.
He can have no complaints about that booking.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 0-0 FULHAM.
It's goalless at the break between United and Fulham.
The visitors made a bright start to the game, and Muniz forced Onana into a great save with his glancing header from a corner.
United didn't even have a shot until the 26th minute, but grew into the game, with Dalot striking the outside of the post from distance.
Shortly after, Muniz rifled his own shot against the woodwork at the other end, before Leno stretched to deny Garnacho's curling effort.
Silva will be pleased with what he's seen so far, with his team looking a threat every time they attacked.
They've caused United real problems, and he'll be looking for more of the same after the break.
The hosts need to make a better start to the second half than they did to the first.
They did create some good chances as the game went on, with Garnacho, in particular, looking dangerous.
United get us back under way for the second half!
Fulham have started the second half in a similar vein to the first.
Castagne wins a corner after making a brilliant overlapping run, but Adarabioyo flicks his header wide from Pereira's delivery.
Casemiro and Reed are both down after a clash of heads in the middle of the park.
The medical teams are on to give them treatment, but neither of them look like they'll be getting back up for a little while yet.
Both Casemiro and Reed are back on their feet, though the Brazilian is still bleeding and is holding a bandage against his head.
He's led straight down the tunnel, but the Fulham midfield is able to carry on.
United are actually going to make a double change.
McTominay is coming on to replace Casemiro, who can't carry on after that head injury.
And Eriksen is being brought on in place of Forson.
OVER! Reed clips a lovely cross into the far post, but Muniz can only flick it onto Castagne behind him.
He lifts it onto Adarabioyo's head, and the defender heads it over the bar before a belated offside flag goes up.
Dalot is dispossessed on the halfway line, and five Fulham players surge forward in support of Iwobi.
He knocks it out to Robinson on his left, but his first-time cross is out of Pereira's reach at the far post.
United are still struggling to get close to Fulham, and their high press isn't causing the visitors any problems.
Silva's men are committing a lot of bodies forward in attack, and they look a real threat.
It's better from United here as they enjoy a spell of possession, but it's all in front of Fulham.
Maguire has his arms out, asking for options in the final third, but none are forthcoming.
Varane's long ball over the top to Fernandes doesn't come to anything, but the defender intercepts Robinson's clearance to get a second bite at it.
This time, he gets too much pace on the cross to Rashford, who can't control it.
SAVE! Garnacho commits himself but doesn't make the interception, leaving the space in behind for Castagne.
His cross almost creeps in and has Onana scrambling back, with the goalkeeper tipping it over.
BASSEY SCORES! It's been coming, and Fulham have the breakthrough! Just like in the first half, Castagne sends his corner into the near post, but this time, it's Bassey who makes the run to meet it.
He scuffs at the volley, but on his second attempt, he makes no mistake as he rifles it into the roof of the net.

events.action: rifles it into the roof of the net

text: 1-0 Fulham!
Castagne is alert in the box and gets to it before any of the United players to set Bassey up for the shot.
United are trying to move the ball quicker than before, but they look very out of sync.
They can't seem to string together enough passes to get into the final third and cause Fulham any problems.
Fulham are making their first change of the game now, and it's Pereira that's going off for Cairney.
United win their first corner of the second half, but Fernandes' cross is over everybody in the middle.
Mainoo makes a late run to the edge of the box, but his volley bounces into the ground and back out to where his captain is.
SAVE! Fernandes leaves Reed on the floor with a lovely bit of footwork, and he opens up a pocket of space in front of him.
He curls a shot towards the far post, but Leno stretches to hold onto it.
There are shouts for a penalty from some of the United fans behind the goal as Maguire goes down inside the box.
He got the slightest of nudges in his back from Castagne, and the referee is having none of it.
Reed has gone down as the cut on his eye from his earlier clash with Casemiro has opened up again.
He needs patching up once more, but he's okay to carry on.
Reed did come back onto the pitch after receiving treatment for the cut on his eye, but he is going off now.
He's replaced by Traore.
GREAT CHANCE! Eriksen is outmuscled by Cairney, and Fulham break on another lightning-quick counter.
He slides it through to Wilson, who takes his shot from the edge of the D, but he curls it wide of the near post.
OVER! Eriksen whips a delightful cross into the six-yard box from a corner, and Maguire gets in front of his marker to meet it.
He thumps a header on goal, but it sails just over the bar.
Both sides are making a change here, starting with United.
Mainoo is going off, with Diallo on to add something different to their attack.
And Fulham's is a defensive swap as they try to see out this win.
Wilson is taken off, with Diop on in his place.
The home crowd are starting to show their frustration as another United attack fizzles out.
Fernandes goes for the big switch out to Garnacho, but he can't keep it in play.
Eriksen steps in to stop Cairney from getting away this time and takes it to the edge of the box.
He thinks about having a shot but lays it off to McTominay instead.
His heavy first touch shows too much of it to Bassey.
Fulham have everybody sitting deep in their own half now, and they're doing a good job of closing down the space ahead of the hosts.
United look a little frantic in possession as they search for a late equaliser.
MAGUIRE EQUALISES! He started things off, holding off Cairney well before taking it to the byline.
His cross ends up falling to Fernandes on the far side, and he cuts inside to lose Castagne before curling a shot on goal.
Leno saves it, but can't hold onto the ball, and spills it straight to Maguire's feet, leaving him to volley it into the net.
Leno is booked in the aftermath of the goal for dissent.
WIDE! There are going to be nine minutes of stoppage time, and United have some belief back now.
McTominay drives into the box and drills a low shot across goal, but it rolls well wide.
GOOD SAVE! Lindelof gets forward to join in the attack, and when the space opens up for him, he decides to have a go himself.
His low shot is heading towards the far bottom corner, but Leno gets down to tip it away.
SAVE! Eriksen loses the ball, but just as quickly wins it back, teeing up Fernandes in the process.
He tries his luck from range again, and Leno pushes it out towards Garnacho, but Adarabioyo just gets there in front of the winger.
GOOD CHANCE! Fulham are back to committing bodies forward, and Castagne just breezes into the box to offer Traore support.
He uses the Belgian, who clips it into Muniz, but he sends his header bouncing wide of the far post.
IWOBI SCORES! Fulham have their lead back late on! Maguire heads it straight to Traore, who knows he has the beating of the defender in a foot race.
He surges to the edge of the D before squaring it to Iwobi to his left.
He coolly touches it around Dalot before slotting his low shot into the bottom-left corner, with Onana static on his line.
2-1 Fulham!
It was a brilliant counter-attack from Traore, who was barely put under any pressure by United as he raced forward.
United's final change sees Lindelof taken off for Antony, though the Brazilian has only seconds to try and make an impact here.
Fernandes picks up a late booking, much to his astonishment, for dissent.
Cairney is also booked for delaying United from taking a throw-in.
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 1-2 FULHAM.
Iwobi's stoppage-time goal seals a dramatic 2-1 win for Fulham to end United's winning run.
The Cottagers were bright throughout but couldn't make the most of their advantage in the first half.
Muniz was denied by Onana and hit the post, while Dalot also struck the woodwork at the other end.
Bassey broke the deadlock, rifling his shot into the roof of the net from a corner, but they were pegged back in the 89th minute.
Leno saved Fernandes' curling shot but spilt it straight to Maguire's feet, and he volleyed in from close range.

Fernandes and Lindelof both saw late chances to win the game pushed away by the goalkeeper before the hosts were caught out by a counter-attack, which Iwobi finished by slotting it into the bottom corner.

events.action: finished by slotting it into the bottom corner

text: Fulham get their first away win since the opening weekend, though they stay 12th in the table.
Next up for them is Brighton at home.
United miss the chance to go level on points with Spurs, staying in sixth.
They're in FA Cup action next against Nottingham Forest.
That's all for today, goodbye!
